verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly documents scheduled tasks for recurring/future prompts (letta-docs-69) and always-on agents that can be combined with schedules and Slack for automation (letta-docs-68, letta-docs-73). However, evidence is a single doc mention with no detail on job/workflow chaining, error handling, or hands-on/independent verification of scheduling reliability. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of workflow-level (multi-step) scheduling vs simple prompt triggers, independent/community confirmation of scheduling working in practice, and any info on failure/retry handling.
